scope.item: Special repair and maintenance (Civil and Electrical Work) of departmental quarter and I.Q.

money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of 18% GST. EMD by DD of any nationalized bank in favour of Pay & Accounts Officer of Lighthouses & Lightships, Noida, or bank guarantee (Annex-II format) in favour of the Director General of Lighthouses & Lightships, Noida. Tender fee Nil.

eligibility: Enlisted contractor with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, NOIDA authority, other Central and State organizations under appropriate classification of bid amount
Satisfactory completion of similar works during last 7 years: three works each >= 40%, or two works each >= 60%, or one work >= 80% of estimated cost
Documentary evidence of adequate financial standing: annual financial turnover not less than 30% of estimated cost
notes: NIT dated 05/05/2025, Section I only (Hindi and English); no BOQ. Bid download/submission 06/05/2025 11:00 to 26/05/2025 15:00; pre-bid 15/05/2025 11:30; technical bid opening 27/05/2025 16:00. Hindi version prints the opening date as 27/05/2024 (typo). Last date for original EMD is 26/05/2025 15:00 in Hindi but 11:30 AM in English. English eligibility list is numbered 6-10. Issued by DGLL headquarters, Noida; the work is at a departmental residential building, not a lighthouse.
